title: RobustMask: Certified Robustness against Adversarial Neural Ranking Attack via Randomized Masking
authors: Jiawei Liu; Zhuo Chen; Rui Zhu; Miaokun Chen; Yuyang Gong; Wei Lu; Xiaofeng Wang
why_relevant: Proposes a certified defense (RobustMask) against adversarial ranking attacks on neural retrievers used in RAG pipelines, directly relevant to adversarial corruption of retrieval.
why_not_or_caveat: Focus is on the retriever/ranker layer rather than the full RAG generation stack.
suggested_section: Adversarial corruption: retrieval attacks and defenses
